Its six basic policies are: expanding the share and strengthening the resilience of its domestic core businesses; establishing global business as a revenue base; expanding businesses to meet new logistics needs; shifting to management that supports portfolio management; implementing human resource management optimized for the whole company; and improving operational efficiency and expanding and upgrading the value provided through DX. Through structural reforms and active investment in growth businesses, it aims to improve growth potential and capital profitability.
